text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion achieved splendid
results in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, we made it through those
truly precious "first three years"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —However!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hey! When's she getting here?
choice_data_list: I think they should be here any minute, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You say that,
but you've already wasted more than 20 minutes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion was supposed to be looking forward to
running alongside Air Shakur today, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...I've hit my limit.
I'm going home—"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting~♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how many times I see it, watching Shakur and
their Trainer together is always amusing."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "...Oi, don't you have something to say before babbling on all easygoing-like?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right!
Then for the two of you—here you go♪

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh? A four-leaf clover...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes! On my way here,
I found a spot where lots of white clover grows.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I thought, 'What if...?' and went looking,
and I actually found a four-leaf clover~!
choice_data_list: Is that your reason for being late?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh my, were you really that late?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Can I just go home after all?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Sorry~?
Inspiration just struck, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Because I've been searching for
a present for the two of you this whole time!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
I made you worry so much, after all, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I know for sure what each of them would love...
but that just feels a bit off.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's why I felt like sharing my feelings...
and giving you something precious to me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Sorry?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You won't forgive me~?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Shut up!
Get over to the starting line already!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yup, be right there!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay!
Off I go~♪
